command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: FR1 promises that Now is shown 'in every state of the main page where the bar is shown: loading, view failed to load, empty list, unreadable stored list, storage unavailable and offline', and task 3.2 rewrites the Gherkin scenario 'Bar in each state' in date_selection_date_bar.feature to '...and an inactive Now' (tagged @FR1). But that behaviour lives in the separate stable requirement 'Date bar on every page state' (openspec/specs/date-selection/spec.md:221, scenario 'Bar in each state': 'THEN the date bar is shown with the previous-day, date and next-day buttons'), and the date-selection delta does not MODIFY it. Neither proposal 'What Changes' nor 'Capabilities' lists it. After archive the stable spec would not match the feature file, and FR1's page-states part has no spec behind it. Add a MODIFIED 'Date bar on every page state' requirement (FR1 of keep-now-button-visible-when-live) with the updated scenario, and list it in What Changes and Capabilities.
